title: Keep the ETM module building once it passes 32 source files (unity-build name clashes in tests)
acceptance: A clean build (no Intermediate folder) compiles with zero errors with more than 32 source files in the module
All ETM automation tests pass after the clean build
description: Found during T-0014. Unreal merges a game module's .cpp files into combined unity files once the module has 32 or more source files (TargetRules.MinGameModuleSourceFilesForUnityBuild = 32). The test files each define helpers with the same names (Frame72, FTestWorld) in anonymous namespaces, so they clash once merged. main has 25 files today and builds clean (checked 17 Nov 2026 from an empty worktree); the T-0014 tree has 38 and fails, and merging the pending branches would push main past 32 too. Fix: bUseUnity = false for the ETM module.
